notes: Central international graduate admission pages (eligibility, English, timeline) apply to all KAIST master's programmes; the department list is JavaScript-loaded and could not be rendered (timeout), so only the central route and the EE department page were collected. Business School MBA/Master pages are Korean-language professional programmes with no usable requirements text; CS, AI (gsai.kaist.ac.kr, empty without JS) and ISysE (robots.txt) pages gave nothing usable. Spring 2027 entry window (August 18 - September 1, 2026) has already closed; Fall 2027 entry is the next intake. TOEFL minimum of 83 applies to tests taken before Jan 21, 2026, 4.5 on the new scale from Jan 21, 2026. Waivers of the English test exist for citizens/graduates of listed English-speaking countries (China not listed). Per-department admissions guidelines may be PDF-only.
